pages.text: Thick fog covered the morning sea. Dad's boat came in with a putt, putt, putt.
They wanted to find Dad's boat in the fog and welcome him. "If we listen, we can tell where it is coming in."
Lolo walked into a foggy alley. Riri stopped right where she was. "We should go toward the sound." "We must stay still to hear it."
Clatter, clatter! Lolo ran toward the sound. It was a bread cart.
Creak, creak! An old gate was swinging in the wind.
Riri stood with her ears pricked. Sounds came from every direction in the fog.
Following the sounds, Riri turned around and around on the spot. Her head felt dizzy.
After going through all the alleys, Lolo stood still. There was only fog, with just the boot tips visible.
Then a putt, putt, putt came from where Lolo stood. Riri heard it and ran toward Lolo.
Dad's boat emerged from the fog. They held Dad's hands and bounced. "Two rabbits have popped out of the fog!" Dad laughed heartily.
